name: fanm
description: AIがMSX風デモを作り続け、静的サイトへ自動公開する。

scripts.start: npm run gallery:build && tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts run
scripts.start:fake: npm run gallery:build && tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts run --fake
scripts.makenow: npm run gallery:build && tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts makenow
scripts.publish: npm run gallery:build && tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts publish
scripts.publish:local: npm run gallery:build && tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts publish --local
scripts.remove: npm run gallery:build && tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts remove
scripts.check:templates: tsx packages/batch/src/cli.ts check templates/ambient templates/game templates/poem templates/adventure templates/rpg templates/action templates/shooter templates/tiles
